name: 25432-mtpdecode-qwen3next80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, four cards of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 256, bounded at 1000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no tools, exactly 2048 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens per request, no spread. Prompts are independently sampled token sequences, so no two share a prefix; greedy, plain completions to /v1/completions, static seed 25432, and every request emits its full 1024 tokens.
purpose: A long-form content generator on a large mixture-of-experts model, serving 256 concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's arguments for this item. Nothing here is tuned or declared tunable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tokenizer-mode: auto
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
max-model-len: 262144

# These two are written out on purpose: built in-process, an unset value resolves to
# 2048 / 128 rather than to the values below, which is a different operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256

# Required for the engine to start at all at this commit, and it must stay on one line --
# the engine's config reader drops indented continuations. Left unset, the engine resolves
# cudagraph_mode=FULL_AND_PIECEWISE and then aborts during capture with
#   AssertionError: GDN only supports decode-only full CUDAGraph capture.
# The default capture sizes are 1, 2, 4 then multiples of 8 up to 512, while one uniform
# decode step here is 1 + num_speculative_tokens = 3 tokens per sequence, so the capture
# asserts unless every size divides by 3. 512 does not, and it is the first size tried.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "PIECEWISE"}
